title: Universal Life Insurance Rider Specification Page: Overloan Protection Rider
content:
The overloan protection rider of Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance lets an owner turn a heavily borrowed policy into paid-up coverage that cannot lapse for indebtedness. Whether a tier includes the rider, and the thresholds and charge percentage attached to it, are specified per tier below.

## Specification

| Item | Lifetime Guarantee UL | Protection UL | Accumulation UL | Indexed UL Protect | Indexed UL Growth | Indexed UL Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Overloan protection rider included | No | No | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Minimum attained age of the insured to exercise | 75 | 75 | 75 | 75 | 75 | 75 |
| Minimum policy year to exercise | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Indebtedness as a share of the account value at or above which the rider may be exercised | 94% | 94% | 94% | 94% | 94% | 94% |
| Overloan charge percentage (share of the account value) | 3.5% | 3.5% | 3.5% | 3.5% | 3.5% | 3.5% |

As decimals the indebtedness threshold is 0.94 and the overloan charge percentage is 0.035.

## Reading the specification

- The rider is included only on the Ashgrove Accumulation UL, Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth and Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier. The figures shown for the other three tiers are specified values of tiers that do not include the rider.
- The thresholds are inclusive: attained age 75, policy year 15 and indebtedness of exactly 94% of the account value each meet their threshold; age 74, policy year 14 or indebtedness of 93.9% do not.

## Hypothetical figures

Indebtedness of $188000.00 against an account value of $200000.00 is 94% of it and meets the threshold; indebtedness of $187000.00 is 93.5% and does not.
